fix: Make `Registry::active` an `Rc<[(u64, Observer)]>`. Start stores `registry.active = Rc::from(following);`. Update, Commit and Cancel keep `registry.borrow().active.clone()`, which becomes an Rc refcount bump with no allocation per progress event. Drop rebuilds the slice only on its rare path: `registry.active = registry.active.iter().filter(|(id, _)| *id != self.id).cloned().collect();`, guarded by a check that this registration was following. The same clone also happens at lines 126 and 133 (Commit and Cancel).

Store the snapshot as `RefCell<Option<Rc<AsyncSnapshot<T, E>>>>`. `FutureBuilderState::snapshot` then returns `Rc<AsyncSnapshot<T, E>>`, so each build clones an Rc instead of the data `T`/`E`. The builder is called with `&snapshot`. The same pattern exists in `StreamBuilderState::build` (line 603, `state.summary.borrow().clone().expect("summary")`), where `summary` should become `RefCell<Option<Rc<B::Summary>>>` and `fold` wraps the step result in `Rc::new`. Avoid holding the RefCell borrow across the user build callback.
